name: Silkguard
oracle_text:
Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to X target creatures you control.
Auras, Equipment, and modified creatures you control gain hexproof until end of turn. (Equipment, Auras you control, and counters are modifications.)
blocked_sentences: Auras, Equipment, and modified creatures you control gain hexproof until end of turn. (Equipment, Auras you control, and counters are modifications.)

needs.what: a selector predicate for "modified" -- a permanent that has one or more counters of any kind on it, or has an Equipment attached to it, or is enchanted by an Aura its controller controls (702.x reminder: "Equipment, Auras you control, and counters are modifications"). It must be usable inside an effect's `objects` (so `grant_keyword` can gather "modified creatures you control"), and, since dozens of queued cards print "Modified creatures you control have trample" and "as long as it's modified", also as a `static_filter_keys` entry and a `static_condition_keys` clause
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `attached` is the closest selector key and is the reverse relation: selectors.py reads it off `ctx.source_oid` and matches only the single permanent the ability's own Aura/Equipment source is attached to (`source.attached_to` / `last_attached_to`), so it cannot ask of an arbitrary creature whether anything is attached TO it, and Silkguard is an instant that is attached to nothing. `counters_on` exists only in `value_keys`/`static_value_keys` -- it is an amount or a side of a `cmp`, never a filter on a pool, and `selector.count` is the pool's size limit, not a counter count. `keywords`/`subtypes`/`any_of` can express the "Auras, Equipment" half but have no term for the third branch, and `STATIC_FILTER_KEYS` is smaller still (no counter or attachment key at all). No card in data/cards/auto/templates.cards.json prints the word "modified"; ~30 queue entries are blocked on it
